culture-cycles.note: The official 2026 national holidays dataset of the Ministry of the Interior lists no additional provincial holiday for Santa Fe Province. National public holidays are on Argentina's record. Recurring provincial patron or foundation days are not in that dataset, so this record does not claim a complete provincial calendar. The 2027 official dataset had not been published when this was checked.
